mapper.update: update img_search_rebuild_job set status = 1, start_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{jobId} and status = 0
update img_search_rebuild_job set success_count = success_count + #{count}, update_time = now() where id = #{jobId}
update img_search_rebuild_job set fail_count = fail_count + #{count}, update_time = now() where id = #{jobId}
update img_search_rebuild_job set status = 2, finish_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{jobId}
update img_search_rebuild_job set status = 3, remark = #{remark}, finish_time = now(), update_time = now() where id = #{jobId}
